text:
sam_marketing: Quick sync 0: new marketing policy for partner/celebrity mentions just landed from legal. We need a short checklist for approvals before any external quote or newsletter inclusion. Building it now.

legal_kate: Posting the checklist here so everyone sees it: 1) No unverified performance percentages. 2) Quotes require an internal consent form signed by partner. 3) Any named endorsements from public figures need PR sign-off + brand clearance. 4) Embargo requests must include a preview clause for charts/quotes.

jonathan_pr: Thanks Kate. Can you add a step for rapid opt-out if the partner requests removal within 48h post-publish?

legal_kate: Good call  added: opt-out window 48h with documented request. Also added a requirement for an approved one-sentence boilerplate if partner wants a short blurb.

elaine: Will update the blog publish runbook to include the checklist and a checkbox for partner consent file. Also adding a CMS field for "partner approval received".

press_ops: For press coordination, we'll require a single point-of-contact (POC) from partner listed in the consent form. Saves time when chasing approvals.

sam_marketing: Draft checklist uploaded: https://internal.redwood/marketing/checklists/partner-endorsement-approval.md (internal). Will send a short training note to the team + update the launch playbook.

jonathan_pr: Let's run a quick 15-min walkthrough tomorrow to align PR + marketing on how to use the checklist for live launches.

legal_kate: I'll be there. If anyone has past examples of tricky approvals, drop them in this thread so we can add FAQ items.

elaine: Dropping one example: celebrity newsletter last-minute wording change forced blog delay. We should include a bump window policy (max 2 edits after final sign-off).

press_ops: Noted. Also recommending we keep an "embargo freeze" flag in the CMS to prevent accidental publishes while partner approvals are pending.

sam_marketing: Great suggestions. I'll finalize the checklist and circulate the training invite. Thanks team :thumbsup:
